吴姜闻言，好奇心瞬间被勾了起来，脚步顿住，追着李强问道：“哦？还有这事儿？你细说细说，到底出了多少意外，能把你表哥愁成这样？”

靳欢欢也凑了过来，脸上满是好奇，显然也被李强的话吸引住了。

三人放慢脚步，李强重重叹了口气，语气里满是无奈，缓缓开口，说起了表哥公司接连发生的怪事。

“说起来就邪门，前阵子先是公司的仓库突然漏水，好几批货都被泡坏了，损失了不少钱；紧接着，办公室的电路突然短路，差点儿引发了一场火灾。”

李强皱着眉，一桩桩一件件数着，“还有办公室的同事，走在路上好好的，就被一个广告牌砸了，歇了快半个月才来上班；就连我，前段时间陪客户喝酒，直接喝了个酒精中毒，要不是抢救的及时，说不定就已经凉凉了，最可惜的是，单子还因为这事给丢了。”

说到这里，李强还拍了拍自己的胳膊，脸上露出几分劫后余生的庆幸：“这还不算完，最近公司里的员工要么生病请假，要么频频出错，客户投诉也多了起来，业务都快停摆了，我表哥天天愁得睡不着觉，头发都白了好几根。”

吴姜听完，又追问了几句细节，眉头渐渐蹙了起来，心里暗自思索：这事儿怎么听着，跟怨煞染运术这么像？可一般的怨煞染运术，都是针对主家本身，让主家倒霉出事，怎么他表哥家里人半点事没有，反倒都是公司的员工频频遭殃？

这一连串的意外，单独看都是偶然，可扎堆凑到一起，就显得格外反常，绝非单纯的运气不好那么简单。

他略一沉吟，看向李强问道：“你表哥就没找明白人看看？这事儿听着挺邪乎的，说不定是哪里出了问题。”

“怎么没找啊！”李强苦笑一声，摇了摇头，“我表哥一开始也以为是运气差，硬扛了一阵子，后来实在顶不住了，找了好几个会看事的人去公司看过，又是摆阵又是念经的，钱花了不少，可半点用都没有，该出意外还是出意外，反倒比之前更严重了。”

吴姜心里了然，想来那些人都是些没真本事的江湖骗子，根本解决不了真问题。

要是有脏东西作乱，他还能帮些忙，可凭着他判断，他表哥公司的事情，多半是风水方面出了纰漏，这一块他就彻底一窍不通了。

他顿了顿，想起了赵安坤，老赵同志在风水玄学方面的造诣极高，绝对是这方面的大师。

于是，吴姜拍了拍李强的肩膀，认真地说道：“强子，我认识一位风水方面的大师，姓赵，本事特别厉害，绿城好多大老板都请他去看事，你可以问问你表哥，要是你表哥需要，我可以帮你介绍一下。”

When Wu Jiang heard this, his curiosity was instantly aroused. He stopped and chased Li Qiang and asked, "Oh? Is there another thing like this? Please tell me in detail, how many accidents happened to make your cousin so worried?"

Jin Huanhuan also came over, her face full of curiosity, and she was obviously attracted by Li Qiang's words.

The three of them slowed down, and Li Qiang sighed heavily. His tone was full of helplessness, and he slowly spoke about the strange things that happened one after another in his cousin's company.

"It sounds weird. A while ago, the company's warehouse suddenly leaked. Several batches of goods were damaged and a lot of money was lost. Then, the circuit in the office suddenly short-circuited, almost causing a fire."

Li Qiang frowned and counted them one by one, "There are also colleagues in the office who were hit by a billboard while walking on the street. They took almost half a month off before coming to work. Even I, who was drinking with a client some time ago, suffered from alcohol poisoning. If I hadn't been rescued in time, I might have become cold. The most regrettable thing is that the order was lost because of this incident."

At this point, Li Qiang patted his arm, with a bit of relief on his face: "This is not over yet. Recently, employees in the company have either taken sick leave or made frequent mistakes. There have been more customer complaints, and the business is almost shut down. My cousin is so worried that he can't sleep every day, and his hair has turned several gray."

After Wu Jiang listened, he asked a few more details, his brows gradually furrowed, and he thought to himself: Why does this sound so similar to the Yuansha Ran Luck Technique?But the general grievance-infecting luck technique is aimed at the owner himself, causing misfortune to happen to the owner. Why is it that nothing happened to his cousin’s family, but the employees of the company frequently suffer?

This series of accidents, when viewed individually, are all accidental, but when taken together, they appear to be extremely abnormal, and they are by no means as simple as bad luck.

He pondered for a moment, looked at Li Qiang and asked, "Didn't your cousin find someone who understands? This thing sounds quite weird. Maybe something went wrong."

"Why didn't you look for it?" Li Qiang smiled bitterly and shook his head, "My cousin thought it was bad luck at first, so he struggled for a while, but then he couldn't stand it anymore. He found several people who could see things and went to the company to see them. They set up formations and chanted sutras. They spent a lot of money, but it was of no use at all. An accident happened anyway, and it turned out to be more serious than before."

Wu Jiang knew clearly in his heart that those people were all charlatans with no real ability and could not solve the real problem at all.

If something dirty makes trouble, he can still help, but based on his judgment, the affairs of his cousin's company are probably due to feng shui flaws, and he is completely ignorant of this aspect.

He paused and thought of Zhao Ankun. Comrade Zhao was extremely accomplished in Feng Shui metaphysics and was definitely a master in this field.

So, Wu Jiang patted Li Qiang on the shoulder and said seriously: "Qiangzi, I know a master in Feng Shui named Zhao. He is very capable. Many big bosses in Greentown ask him to see things. You can ask your cousin. If your cousin needs it, I can help you introduce him."
